topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Finding my college application essay published as an example was a surprising turn, a thread of light through the fabric of my routine. It's an honor, really, to think that my words might guide someone, perhaps a nervous student on the brink of their own journey. I remember the nights I spent under the soft glow of my desk lamp, each sentence a step forward, a piece of myself laid out in hopes and honest reflections. To know that it resonates, that it could offer comfort or inspiration, fills me with a quiet joy. It’s a connection, a way to reach out and say, "You’re not alone in this."
